welcomeMessage: Welcome to Calvary Chapel Antelope Valley! We are glad you are here. Whether you are joining us in person or online, may God bless you today.

announcements.title: Men's Breakfast
announcements.body: Men, come out on Saturday May 16th for our men’s breakfast from 8 AM - 10 AM here at the church. There will be food, fellowship and the Word brought to us by guest speaker Rich Smith from Calvary Chapel Frazier Park. Please sign up in the foyer!

announcements.title: Marriage Couples Fellowship
announcements.body: Come be refreshed in your marriage Friday, May 22nd at 7:00 PM here at the church as we study the Word, fellowship with other married couples, and share a meal together. This is a potluck event, so please bring a dish to share. Childcare will not be provided, so please plan accordingly. Sign-up sheet and flyers are in the foyer.

announcements.title: Paul Deaville’s Celebration of Life
announcements.body: Come and join us Saturday, May 23rd at 11:00 AM to celebrate the life and homecoming of our beloved brother Paul Deaville and his love for Jesus, which has impacted so many members of this body.

announcements.title: Youth Hiking Trip
announcements.body: Junior High and High Schoolers come join us Saturday June 13th as we hike the “ Trail Of The Hundred Giants” in the Sequoias. We will meet at the church at 7 AM. Sign up in the Foyer by June 7th . A 2026 Youth Emergency Form is required if one has not already been filled out. More info on the flyer in the foyer

announcements.title: Care Net Change for Life Baby Bottle Fundraiser
announcements.body: Pick up a baby bottle in the foyer to help support Care Net as they minister to mothers, babies, and families in our community. Fill it with change, cash, or checks, and return it to the church by Father’s Day. More info is available on the flyers in the foyer.

announcements.title: 2026 Women’s Conference
announcements.body: Join us Saturday, June 27th from 9:30 AM to 3:30 PM for our 2026 Women’s Conference. The theme is “Be Strong” from Proverbs 31:25, with guest speakers Ruth Beeler, Michelle Randall, Sonia Trujillo, and our pastor’s wife Desiree Hueser. Cost is $35 per person, lunch included. Please register and pay as soon as possible by scanning the QR code on the flyers located in the foyer. Registration is open until all spots are full.
